post.description: Additive only: the target is the live account whose normalized email equals the manifest's emailAtBackup (email/password/role/profile untouched). Original bytes are deduped by checksum and old asset ids are remapped to live assets for album/share links. Rows first, bytes second, derivative jobs third. Adoption then moves the source snapshot into the live prefix: missing originals are server-side copied, the source manifest is unioned with any existing live manifest (live entries win, shares dedupe by token), the union is written last and the source prefix is deleted — the account reads as a normal backed-up row instead of a legacyBackups sub-row. HARD PREREQUISITE: keep cleanup-orphans paused until the merge completion log. A second plain merge of the same source is 409 already-merged; force replays/upserts the ledger. Partial failure: if adoption fails (unreadable live manifest or S3 error) merge rows/bytes stay, the ledger and source delete are skipped, and the response reports assigned:null plus adoptionError so a plain retry stays allowed.

It moves on asset add/delete/trash/restore, any asset mutation (dates, title, favourite), a hidden-album toggle or membership change, and album membership changes in `albumId` views. Only windows with items are returned: a newly non-empty month appears, an emptied one disappears.

info.title: Photox API
info.description:
Photo hosting API.

**Versioning.** The path version (`/api/v1`) is additive-only: new routes, fields, optional
parameters and error codes may appear at any time. Removing or renaming a field, route or error
code, or changing a status code's meaning, is breaking and needs a new path version.

**Deprecation.** A route that will be removed is marked `deprecated` here, answers with
`Deprecation` (RFC 9745), `Sunset` (RFC 8594, see `x-sunset`) and a `Link: rel="successor-version"`
header, and keeps working for at least one release. Nothing is removed silently and nothing is
deprecated without a named replacement.

**Frozen surfaces.** `/api/share/:token/*` is permanent — share tokens are embedded in links
that outlive any deploy, so that namespace never changes shape. `/worker/*` and `/health` are
internal and unversioned: they may change without notice.

**Concurrency.** Byte reads (`/assets/:id/content`, `/files/:fileId/stream`, and the public
share content routes) carry a strong `ETag` and honour `If-None-Match`/`Range`;
`/faces/:id/thumb` is immutable-cached but has no revalidation. JSON resources are last-write-wins:
`updatedAt` in the payload is the only change signal, there is no `If-Match` check.

**Paging.** Every list answers `{items, total}`, plus `nextCursor` on keyset routes. `total` is the
endpoint's match count, never a page size (ranked routes report candidates: `/search`, `duplicates`,
`similar`). One walk per collection:

| Collection | Walk | limit default/max |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/assets` | cursor; `offset` only on the first call | 20 / 100 |
| `/albums/{id}/assets` | cursor; `offset` only on the first call | 20 / 100 |
| `/shares` | cursor only | 20 / 200 |
| `/api/share/{token}/assets` | cursor only | 100 / 500 |
| `/search` | offset | 20 / 100 |
| `/albums` | offset | 20 / 1000 |
| `/persons` | offset | 20 / 1000 |
| `/admin/users` | offset | 20 / 50 |
| `/admin/backups/overview` | offset | 50 / 200 |
| `/timeline/window` | `nextOffset` inside one window | 2000 / 5000 |

ApiError.description: The single body shape for every non-2xx response (`ApiErrorBody` in @photox/shared-types). Clients branch on the stable `code`, never on the prose `message`; `Retry-After` is also sent as a header when `retryAfterSec` is present. Served as `application/json`, or as `application/problem+json` when the request asks for it. This is not an RFC 7807 document: `code` plays `type` (a stable enum instead of a URI), `message` plays `detail`, and `requestId` plays `instance`.
